# Navigation

How a person moves: between areas, between views, and down into a record and back out, one control and one motion each.

**Kind:** Pattern

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/storybook-docs/patterns/Navigation/Navigation.mdx`

## The tiers

Four tiers, from the whole app down to one record. A quick look is a layer, not a tier; steps move within a level.

- **1 · Areas.** Go to: the Sidebar's fixed items. The selected row takes the selected fill.
- **1b · Open items.** Records the person opened, a session or a student, as temporary items in the Sidebar: add and remove, then go to.
- **2 · Views.** Pill views in a Section's view bar, or page tabs under the page title. Content swaps in place.
- **3 · Drill in and climb out.** A record page with a breadcrumb: the record's place, parents only. Climb out through the breadcrumb.

## Key cases

## Usage

Choose the navigation tier first; it sets the control, placement and motion. Navigation belongs in the Sidebar and page. There is no Topbar or global search.

| Tier | The move | Control | Motion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 · Areas | To another part of the app | A Sidebar item | Go to |
| 1b · Open items | To a session or student opened earlier | A temporary item in the Sidebar, named by when and who | Add and remove, then Go to |
| 2 · Views | Between views of one collection or record | Pill views in the view bar; page tabs under the title | Switch views: content in place, the indicator glides |
| 3 · Drill in and climb out | Into one record and back | A row, then the breadcrumb | Drill in, Climb out |
| Within a level | Through a task's steps | Back and Next in the bottom bar; the step rail | Step |
| A layer | A quick look without leaving | A Details Panel or a Modal | Open and Close |

### Opening a record

Least room to most. Pick the lowest step that fits. The picture is on Templates.

| Step | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| 1 · Expand the row | A few more lines, links at most. |
| 2 · Section detail | On a queue page, the record opens beside its list. |
| 3 · Details Panel | A quick look or a short edit from a table on any other page. |
| 4 · Modal | A rare, critical task with fewer than five fields. |
| 5 · Its own page | Complex or stepped work, or anything worth a URL. The breadcrumb appears. |

## Alternatives

- For narrowing a collection rather than switching views, follow Filtering; filters combine, views do not.
- For more pills than fit, fold the extras into "More" ; keep page tabs to five.
- For a decision that blocks the page, use a Modal, not a page.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Views as short parallel nouns: "Upcoming", "Past". | "Show upcoming sessions", "History". |
| Page tabs name views of one subject: "Overview", "Sessions", "Notes". | Counts or status in the tab label. |
| The view Select is labeled: "Status: Upcoming" . | A bare "Upcoming". |
| Breadcrumb levels by the page's own title. | "Back", "Home" as a level. |
| Open item: "4:00 PM · Ms. Ortiz". | "Session #1028". |

## Accessibility

- The Sidebar is a navigation landmark; the selected item carries `aria-current="page"`. The selected row is a fill, not color on the icon alone.
- Views and page tabs are a real tab widget: one tab stop, Left and Right move selection, the panel is named by its tab.
- The breadcrumb is a `nav` around an `ol`; the last item is plain text with `aria-current="page"`.
- Leaving a focused task returns focus to the control that opened it .

## Related

- Overflow: use for the breadcrumb middle and open-item names.
- Search: use for narrowing as you type inside a view.
- Filtering: use for narrowing a view by attributes.
- Indicators: use for counts on Sidebar items.
- Frame, Page, Section: use for the drawn shells.
- `Sidebar`, `Breadcrumb`, `Tabs`, `PageHeader`, `Select`: the components.

## Motion

Navigation reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| area | Go to another area | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-default` | The Sidebar highlight glides on spatial.fast; the page fades through on appearance.default. |
| open-item | Add or remove an item | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Opening a record adds an open item to the Sidebar; closing one removes it. Picking one is Go to another area. |
| view | Switch views | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Only the selected indicator glides; the content swaps in place. |
| swap | Swap content in place | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Filters swap the content in place. |
| drill | Drill into and climb back out | `--ds-motion-spatial-default` | Drilling into a record moves on spatial.default. |
| climb | Drill into and climb back out | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` | Climbing out moves on spatial.fast. The Breadcrumb never animates on its own. |

## Best practices

### Show the breadcrumb only after drilling into a record. {#show-the-breadcrumb-only-after-drilling-into-a-record}

**Checked:** Automatic

Never on an area page or a focused task. It sits above the title in the page header and shows the record's place: parents only, never history. It never wraps. Folding five or more items into "…" is Planned .

Do: A breadcrumb on the record page, parents only.
Don't: A breadcrumb on an area page: there is nothing to climb out of.

### Keep one tab system per page. {#keep-one-tab-system-per-page}

**Checked:** Review

Page tabs under the title, or pill views in a Section's bar, never both. Under page tabs a Section's views become one Select at the start of its bar. It picks a view, not a filter.

Do: Under page tabs the Section's views are one Select at the start of its bar.
Don't: Page tabs and pill views on one page: two tab systems.

### Make views a fixed set the product defines. {#make-views-a-fixed-set-the-product-defines}

**Checked:** Review

Two to five views of the same rows, named by short parallel nouns. Nobody adds or edits views. One pill stays even with one view, so nothing moves when a second arrives.

### Swap content in place between views and tabs. {#swap-content-in-place-between-views-and-tabs}

**Checked:** Automatic

Only the selected indicator glides. Nothing slides between views.

### Open a record at the lowest step that fits. {#open-a-record-at-the-lowest-step-that-fits}

**Checked:** Review

Expand the row, then Section detail, then the Details Panel, then a Modal, then its own page. Section detail and the Details Panel both stay: the detail for a queue, the Panel for a table on any other page.

### Give a long task its own focused Frame. {#give-a-long-task-its-own-focused-frame}

**Checked:** Automatic

Close at the start of the title row, no Sidebar, no breadcrumb. How the steps, the title row and the bar sit is on Frame.

### Name an open item by when and who. {#name-an-open-item-by-when-and-who}

**Checked:** Automatic

"4:00 PM · Ms. Ortiz", with the school in the Tooltip. Three show, then "Show n more". Removing one is Add and remove; opening one is Go to.

Do: Each item names the session by its time and the teacher.
Don't: Each item carries everything, and the time it is found by is cut off.

### Put the collection's add action in its view bar, not the page header. {#put-the-collection-s-add-action-in-its-view-bar-not-the-page-header}

**Checked:** Automatic

"Add student" is the Primary at the end of the Students view bar. Page actions sit at the end of the title row and are only about the page.
